title: Jordan psionically calls in an 'egg' object that Fred Baker films
place_text: Skywatcher event site, patio and backyard

tellings.quote: One example: in August one of our main psi-actives, Jordan, probably caused object, and it could to be an "egg". I don't know What is this?

plain: A member of Skywatcher, a startup that says it can summon UFOs, says that in August 2024 one of its "psi-actives" (people it says can call objects with their minds), Jordan Jose, "probably caused" an object to appear that may have been an "egg", and that Fred Baker filmed it. The Skywatcher teller was there and describes it to Michels as happening at the group's event site, on the patio and in the backyard, while admitting, "I don't know what is this."
